ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Response to the Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's response to the Minneapolis shooting, including the initial claims made about the victim and the subsequent backlash.
questions: What did the Trump administration know about the shooting?
What was the basis for their initial claims about the victim?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant scandal and to hold the Trump administration accountable for their actions. I would approach this story by following the money and investigating the administration's financial ties to the Minneapolis police department.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the amount of money involved and the individuals and organizations responsible.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant scandal and to hold individuals and organizations accountable for their actions. I would approach this story by analyzing data and investigating the financial ties between the individuals and organizations involved.
